risks.risk: Resistance system may be faulty (e.g., not smooth, not changing levels, or noisy).
risks.proof: A short video showing resistance level changes while pedaling (front and side angles), plus a close-up of the resistance control/knob and flywheel area.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not fully reliable resistance (worst case: needs repair or limited function).

risks.risk: Drive wear (belt/chain) or pedal/crank play could cause noise or slipping.
risks.proof: Video of pedaling at low and high resistance with a side view of the drive line; also show the chain/belt condition close-up.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worn/unknown condition (worst case: may require maintenance).

risks.risk: Console/monitor (if present) may not work or may be missing.
risks.proof: Photo of the console screen powered on (or a video turning it on) and a close-up of any model label near the console.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as console not working or not included.

risks.risk: Frame stability and adjustments (seat/handlebar rails) may be loose or bent.
risks.proof: Photos of seat height adjustment and handlebar adjustment rails, plus a video showing the bike being rocked and adjustments locked.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possible looseness/adjustment issues (worst case: needs tightening/repair).

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories (water bottle holder, safety knob, pedals, transport wheels, tools) or incomplete setup.
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (pedals, tools, manual, any accessories) and a checklist of included parts.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown inclusions (worst case: missing small parts).

proof_requests: Close-up photo of any brand/model plate or serial number (usually near the frame/console).
Video: pedaling while changing resistance levels (front + side angles).
Close-up of the drive line (belt/chain) and a short noise test video.
Photo/video of the console powering on (if it exists).
Photos of seat/handlebar adjustment locks and a stability/rock test video.
response.reason: The photo confirms it is a spinning/fitness bike, but the brand/model and key working-condition details (resistance, console, drive wear) are not verifiable remotely, so a safe worst-case price can’t be set without the decisive proof.
